The '''2013–14 Serie A''' (known as the [[Serie A]] [[Telecom Italia Mobile|TIM]] for sponsorship reasons) was the 112th season of top-tier Italian [[association football|football]], the 82nd in a [[round-robin tournament]], and the 4th since its organization under a league committee separate from [[Serie B]]. The season began on 24 August 2013 and concluded on 18 May 2014. As in previous years, [[Nike, Inc.|Nike]] provided the official ball for all matches with a new Nike Incyte model used throughout the season. [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] were the defending champions, and successfully defended their title to win a third Serie A title in a row with a record-breaking 102 points. Juventus's title was also their 30th league title in their history earning them the right to add a third gold star to their crest. 

A total of 20 teams competed in the league: 17 sides from the [[2012–13 Serie A|2012–13 season]] and three promoted from the [[2012–13 Serie B]] campaign. [[Palermo F.C.|Palermo]], [[Delfino Pescara 1936|Pescara]] and [[S.S. Robur Siena|Siena]] were each demoted from the top flight. They were replaced by Serie B champion [[U.S. Sassuolo Calcio|Sassuolo]], runner-up [[Hellas Verona F.C.|Hellas Verona]] and play-off winner [[U.S. Livorno 1915|Livorno]]. Hellas Verona returned to Serie A after an 11-year absence, Livorno after four seasons and this season marked Sassuolo's Serie A debut.

For the first time in the competition's history, there were five [[Local derby|derbies]] among teams from the same city: [[Milan]] ([[Inter Milan|Internazionale]] and [[A.C. Milan|Milan]]), [[Turin]] ([[Juventus FC|Juventus]] and [[Torino F.C.|Torino]]), [[Rome]] ([[S.S. Lazio|Lazio]] and [[A.S. Roma|Roma]]), [[Genoa]] ([[Genoa C.F.C.|Genoa]] and [[U.C. Sampdoria|Sampdoria]]), and [[Verona]] ([[A.C. ChievoVerona|Chievo]] and [[Hellas Verona F.C.|Hellas Verona]]).

===Scoring===
*'''First goal of the season''': [[Andrea Poli|Poli]] ([[A.C. Milan|Milan]]) in [[Hellas Verona F.C.|Hellas Verona]]–[[A.C. Milan|Milan]] 2–1, 15 minutes (24 August 2013)
*'''Fastest goal of the season''': [[Gianluca Sansone|Sansone]] ([[U.C. Sampdoria|Sampdoria]]) in [[U.S. Sassuolo Calcio|Sassuolo]]–[[U.C. Sampdoria|Sampdoria]] 1–2, 18 seconds (26 March 2014)

===Discipline===
*'''First yellow card of the season''': [[Jorginho (footballer, born December 1991)|Jorginho]] ([[Hellas Verona F.C.|Hellas Verona]]) in [[Hellas Verona F.C.|Hellas Verona]]–[[A.C. Milan|Milan]] 2–1, 20 minutes (24 August 2013)
*'''First red card of the season''': [[Paolo Castellini|Castellini]] ([[U.C. Sampdoria|Sampdoria]]) in [[U.C. Sampdoria|Sampdoria]]–[[Juventus FC|Juventus]] 0–1, 90 minutes (24 August 2013)
